title: Workshop floor in the shutdown
prompt: Wide documentary photograph of a large timber joinery workshop during the end-of-year summer shutdown: panel saws and machines covered with grey dust sheets, the concrete floor swept clean, sheets of board stacked neatly in racks, overhead lights off. Late-afternoon summer sun streams through high windows and a half-open roller door, laying long warm shafts of light and shadow across the empty floor. Still, quiet, no people, natural muted colours.
promptSuffix: No text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no brand names, no watermarks. If people appear they are anonymous and not looking at the camera.
